Contact Bobby Scott
If you want to share your comments or views on a Federal issue you can email me from this
page. Please Click the link below to e-mail me.  The first step will be to verify your zip code on
the next page, which will bring you to a short email form to ensure that I receive your contact
information.
  
If you need immediate assistance, please call my Newport News Office at (757) 380-1000 or my
Richmond Office at (804) 644-4845 and a member of my staff will assist you.
  
To ensure that your correspondence is responded to as promptly as possible, please note the
following before e-mailing Rep. Scott:
    
    -  CASEWORK:  If you need assistance with a Federal Agency, please click here .  
    -  TOURS: If you are planning a trip to Washington, DC and would like help scheduling
Congressional tours, please 
click here .  
    -  MEDIA INQUIRIES: If you are a member of the Press, please direct all Media Inquiries to
the Press Secretary in the Washington Office (202-225-8351).
  
    -  SCHEDULING: If you would like to invite Congressman Scott to an event, please click
here
.  
  E-Mail Rep. Bobby Scott  
If you prefer, please feel free to call or write one of my offices:
